units.titles: Missing caller authentication in execute_receive_nft allows malicious actors to steal funds from legitimate depositors | Untrusted user_address in execute_receive_nft enables unauthorized withdrawals | Incorrect loss percentage calculation | Missing price bound checks in Deposit and ReceiveNft enable sandwich attacks
units.known_address_notes: Oak Security audit (2025-10-15) of Nawa Finance's ZIGChain CosmWasm contracts (stZIG vault: redeem/deposit/execute_receive_nft). Nawa publishes no address list; the two live CosmWasm vaults (stZIG vault + USDC vault) were taken from the DefiLlama adapter and confirmed on ZIGChain mainnet (chain-id zigchain-1) via LCD contract_info. Exact code_id/revision audited by Oak is not stated in the report, so the audited instance is mapped by vault role rather than by code hash.

units.known_address_notes: Repo moved web3well/bls-wallet -> getwax/bls-wallet. contracts/networks/arbitrum-goerli.json is the project's own deployment registry for chainid 421613 (genesisBlock 18628869, deployedBy 0x9D5e..., version 0d52ddb2 matching the audited era): verificationGateway 0xE25229..., blsExpander 0x30Ae0d..., precompileCostEstimator 0x6eb8F8..., utilities 0x4bD2E4..., testToken 0x30e69A.... Only testnet artifacts exist - there is no networks/*.json for a mainnet chain, which supports the corpus chain labe
